title: RepoMesh Leader Actions Structured Error v1
description: Every non-2xx response of the three leader endpoints. FastAPI's `detail` envelope is kept for consistency with the rest of the API surface, but detail is structured: a machine-readable code from the frozen enum plus a human-readable message. The code-to-HTTP-status mapping is frozen in fixtures/error-matrix.json and pinned by contract tests; a server may not reuse a code under a different status.
